related.title: OpenTelemetry Collector：敏感欄位移除與觀測保留
related.titleEn: OpenTelemetry Collector: redaction while retaining observability
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付240格回歸矩陣、6個差異分析、映射版本與後端事件ID差集。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the 240-cell regression matrix, six discrepancy analyses, mapping versions and backend event-ID differences.
related.difference: 畫出receiver、processor、exporter的資料路徑，確認所有輸出分支都經過必要遮罩或刪除。
related.differenceEn: Map receiver, processor and exporter paths, confirming every output branch passes required redaction or deletion.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 回歸一致率=符合預期的案例後端配對/所有配對；查詢成功編譯不保證命中語義正確。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 80個標籤案例在3個後端測試，共240個判定；其中234個符合預期。 一致率234/240=97.5%；6個差異必須回到欄位與型別檢查。
移除完整率=已正確移除的敏感欄位/所有標記敏感欄位；還要另測必要追蹤欄位是否保留。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 100筆合成事件各含2個敏感欄位，共200個；目前正確移除190個。 完整率190/200=95%，仍殘留10個假敏感欄位。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Regression agreement counts expected case-backend decisions; successful query compilation does not prove semantic equivalence. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Eighty labeled fixtures tested on three backends produce 240 decisions, of which 234 match expectations. Agreement=234/240=97.5%; investigate the six differences through fields and types.

Redaction completeness is correctly removed sensitive fields over all labeled sensitive fields; separately verify useful trace fields remain. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. One hundred synthetic events each contain two sensitive fields, totaling two hundred; 190 are correctly removed. Completeness=190/200=95%, leaving ten fake sensitive fields.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: NIST鑑識流程：雜湊與保管鏈完整性
related.titleEn: NIST forensic process: hashes and chain-of-custody completeness
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付240格回歸矩陣、6個差異分析、映射版本與後端事件ID差集。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the 240-cell regression matrix, six discrepancy analyses, mapping versions and backend event-ID differences.
related.difference: 記錄來源、取得時間、操作者、工具、雜湊及每次交接；保留原件與工作副本的關係。
related.differenceEn: Record source, acquisition time, operator, tool, digest and every handoff, linking originals to working copies.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 回歸一致率=符合預期的案例後端配對/所有配對；查詢成功編譯不保證命中語義正確。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 80個標籤案例在3個後端測試，共240個判定；其中234個符合預期。 一致率234/240=97.5%；6個差異必須回到欄位與型別檢查。
保管鏈完整率=必要欄位齊全的交接/預期交接；雜湊只能支持位元一致，不能證明來源敘述真實。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 12個合成證據檔各需3次交接，共36筆；34筆有完整雙方、時間與雜湊紀錄。 完整率34/36=94.4444%；兩筆缺項仍必須列為限制。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Regression agreement counts expected case-backend decisions; successful query compilation does not prove semantic equivalence. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Eighty labeled fixtures tested on three backends produce 240 decisions, of which 234 match expectations. Agreement=234/240=97.5%; investigate the six differences through fields and types.

Custody completeness counts fully documented required handoffs; hashes support byte equality, not the truth of origin claims. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Twelve synthetic evidence files require three handoffs each, thirty-six total; thirty-four include complete parties, time and digest. Completeness=34/36=94.4444%; disclose the two incomplete handoffs as limitations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
